title: cli: os migrate plan lists sys_packages under "declared by no object in this plan" right after os migrate apply created it — the unmanaged-table sweep's known set omits the one table migrate itself plans outside the object set
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a product defect at a public door, measured. **`reach:`** `os migrate plan` on `examples/app-crm`, run straight after `os migrate apply --yes` against the same file. Measured at base `bb14934cd` and at PR #24053's head `c4adb868c`. Both runs print, under "table(s) in the database(s) this plan covers carry a reserved platform prefix (…) and are declared by no object in this plan:":
- `• sys_legacy_widget` (the fixture's own stranded table, rightly reported);
- `• sys_packages`, a table that same apply created.

So every applied deployment's plan reports its live package registry table as if it were stranded. The section says nothing drops it, but it tells the operator a table the platform owns is declared by nothing.

**Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 2 (seat post #22648) · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT`, from #23899's dev report (`6225291587`, out-of-scope finding 1, class a). ⛔ Not a claim; the grade and lane are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat, for `packages/cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.ts` and its caller in `os migrate plan`.

## Where (`origin/main` `905f57bc7`)

- `packages/cli/src/utils/unmanaged-tables.ts` `buildKnownTableNames` (about `:250`). The known set is the plan's managed set plus every declared object's name and mapped table name. `selectUnmanagedTables` then reports every platform-prefixed physical table outside it.
- `sys_packages` is neither. It is not an object. `PackageServicePlugin.start()` creates it with raw DDL (`packages/services/service-package/src/index.ts`, about `:370`–`:394`). Since #23022, `os migrate apply` plans it as "the one table outside the object set" (`packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`, about `:295`–`:349` and `:1164`).
- So one tool plans the table and creates it, and its sibling sweep calls the same table stranded.

## Done when

- `os migrate plan` after `os migrate apply` on `examples/app-crm` no longer lists `sys_packages` as unmanaged. A genuinely stranded `sys_*` table (the fixture's `sys_legacy_widget`) is still listed.
- The known set takes `sys_packages` from the same source `schema-migrate.ts` plans it from, not from a second hand-typed list. A pin fails against today's sweep.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: `os migrate plan unmanaged tables sys_packages declared by no object after apply` gave 33 hits. The first ten were read. #23022 (closed) is the producer card: it made `apply` plan `sys_packages`, and it did not touch the sweep. The other nine are other `migrate` defects (#21732, #21054, #23925, #23948, #23848, #23397, #23398, #22984, #23552). None is this sweep.

Dedupe words: unmanaged tables sys_packages declared by no object; migrate plan unmanaged sweep sys_packages; reserved prefix sys_packages after apply.
